title: Starting on drums at 23, lessons and early bands
summary: He started drums at 23, studied with Cantrell and Chaligny, then joined Dejan's orchestra; the interviewer recalls lake and boat jobs together.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: When did you start in music? What was your first instrument?
Drums. Drums. You started right on drums. Right on drums.
Well you didn't start when you were a little kid now.

No, I started when I was quite a man. In 23 I started. I mean I started to practice it. But when I got out playing music it was around about 25. Because I went to the old man Cantrell for music lessons and reading lessons. And then after I went to Shalini. Old man Shalini, I went to him for about a year and a half or two years. And the first I went to Shalini and I wound up with Mr. Cantrell. And that's when, after I was there about two years, close to three years with him, then I went to Dejune's Orchestra. I think that's when I met him. You come and got me. Somebody come and got me.
Yeah, but we had a band before you went with that. Oh yeah, well yeah we had the Dejohn Phillips band. And we played at the lake together. At the lake together.

Millenburg, yeah with Willis-Darrisburg. And oh we played in a lot of places. That's what you get in there. We played at the Bamel apartment. We waked out on the boat. Which was on the lake or on the river?
No, on the Madison. On the Madison and the river.

Yeah, on the lake. On the Madison you see. Yeah, perfectly. Running from the Orleans to Madisonville. And we went to several places. Tell us a little bit more about your lessons and how come you picked up drums.
